# MR SEWING FASHION — FINAL CORRECTION VERIFICATION AND WEBSITE READINESS REPORT

Date: 5 November 2026. Branch: `phase1/customer-journey-repairs`. Baseline: `433107ea259fcede6a2a7a057f752dd3151b3a32`. Delivery commit: the Git commit containing this report; full SHA is stamped in the external delivery copy and final message.

## Readiness decision

**NOT READY for production or complete functional sign-off.** Corrected code and local visual review evidence are available. Actual new staging deployment, private backend activation, approved pricing Sources and real email receipt remain blocked. Publication cannot be recommended. No production/main/domain/payment changes or sitemap submission were performed.

The owner confirmed that the previous staging deployment at433107e was successful and still showed the old About Collections button. Git source confirms that old button. Therefore that missing About correction was a real code omission, not something the old commit could prove complete. The new fix opens a five-service menu reused from the header, rather than a simple Services overview link.

## Deployment findings

- Initial local and GitHub development HEAD were433107e. Remote main wasba27bab0425a9df1948fe8f45dd3b941cb322f4c. Full changed-file inventory for433107e has294 paths and is included in evidence.
- Staging URL: https://mrsewing-staging.pages.dev/ . **The new served commit and deployment ID are not independently verified.** Last prior success is owner-reported433107e; do not infer the new deployed SHA from a Git push.
- The environment proxy rejected CONNECT to the staging host with403 before Cloudflare. No Cloudflare account credentials or identity are connected. Actual project branch/repository/build settings and cache state could not be read. There is no evidence establishing wrong branch, a Cloudflare build failure or caching as the cause.
- Supported network draft update failed withCONFLICT/draft_not_editable; no network configuration save/application was confirmed. Proposed network settings are preserved in the review attachment. Exact owner actions are in STAGING_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED.md.
- `/build-info.json` now exposes a non-sensitive release fingerprint. Cloudflare CI can stamp CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA/CF_PAGES_BRANCH; the committed local fallback has a null commit deliberately. A null value is not a deployed-commit claim.

## Completed code

Measurement submission CTA and neck-to-trouser enlargement; general quotation shared with Special; dedicated forms for four services; same-page FAQ Terms acceptance; consultation/legacy form header fix; genuine portfolio related work and enquiry action; header-derived About service menu; useful breadcrumbs;14-page SEO mapping and corrected unsupported metadata. Approved homepage layout,375 existing media files and five service hero photographs are retained.

The secure API application is implemented, locally persisted and bundled successfully for Pages Functions. It issues actual references, stores image associations privately, guards staff reads with signed JWT/allowlist checks, validates images and origin/limits, deduplicates requests, handles notification failures and exposes only authenticated private images. **It remains disabled until documented Cloudflare bindings, actual staff auth, captcha, recipient/privacy/plan setup and real staging tests are complete.** Existing text-provider acceptance is not internal persistence or inbox receipt. Do not use real customer uploads during this unverified phase.

## SEO scope

_data/seo-keyword-map.json maps global/Rwanda/Kigali intent to the14 requested public types. It uses owner-provided search themes and repository content/intent review; no verified search-volume or rankings data. Homepage covers the brand and broad tailoring/alterations/care; service pages cover their actual services; Men's/Women's pages cover suit references; guides answer educational fabric/measurement intent; portfolio/about/contact/FAQ have their own intent. No repeated keyword paragraphs or doorway pages.

The About description's unsupported2019 claim and FAQ description's unverified Cotton-price claim were removed. Useful existing titles/keywords/canonicals/social metadata/schema remain where accurate. Production SEO configuration is untouched; staging host noindex is retained in code/headers but new actual HTTP headers cannot be verified here. No production sitemap was submitted.

## Remaining operational/source decisions

1. Restore environment connectivity and read-only Cloudflare deployment access; verify the actual staged SHA/deployment ID, build settings and routes. Prior433107e success is owner-provided evidence only for that revision.
2. Configure staging D1/privateR2/Access/Turnstile/rate secret/verified notification recipient; keep the feature flag false until real end-to-end tests pass. No purchase, public bucket or auth bypass was made. Staff UI is read-only and lists the latest100 requests; larger-scale pagination and status management need operational review, not invented acceptance policies.
3. Supply original V5/latest approved suit schedule and commercial reconciliation/publication clearance; fabric-only prices separate. The eight named company-original files remain unavailable as listed in the source matrix. No numeric pricing was fabricated.
4. Verify an approved safe test inbox and actual provider delivery. A positive provider response alone is not receipt.
5. Review processor, data-retention/deletion, plan costs/limits and legal matters before real uploads; no certification, fixed retention or final VIP contract is invented. Unsaved selected image files remain in browser memory until submission; they are not persisted as resumable browser drafts.

See STAGING_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED.md for exact account steps, bindings, network hosts and privacy/security limitations. No final VIP terms/FAQs, paid subscriptions, Shop/Royal/Referral activation, Search & Answer Centre or order-confirmation/payment system was activated.
